description: This Java class defines the OrderAttribute, which extends BaseAttribute to represent attributes associated with an Order in the OpenMRS system. It includes getters and setters for the order and its ID, and is annotated for auditing.

classes.name: OrderAttribute
classes.description: Represents an attribute associated with an Order, extending BaseAttribute with specialized methods for order attributes.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Returns the Order object associated with this attribute by invoking getOwner() from BaseAttribute.

methods.name: setOrder
methods.description: Sets the Order object for this attribute by invoking setOwner() from BaseAttribute.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this OrderAttribute, delegating to getOrderAttributeId().

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the identifier for this OrderAttribute, delegating to setOrderAttributeId().

methods.name: getOrderAttributeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of this order attribute.

methods.name: setOrderAttributeId
methods.description: Sets the ID for this order attribute.
